'''''Medicago marina''''' is a plant species of the genus ''[[Medicago]]''. It is native to the Mediterranean basin but is found worldwide. It forms a [[symbiosis|symbiotic]] relationship with the bacterium ''[[Sinorhizobium meliloti]]'', which is capable of [[nitrogen fixation]]. Common names include '''coastal medick''' and '''sea medick'''.
